**Work at Blissway: Opportunity for Impact Every Day 🚀✨**
 Blissway is a startup that simplifies toll collection and dramatically improves highway safety. We are multiple startups in one:
 **Deep Tech, AI/ML, Hardware, SaaS, and IoT.** 
 For the past five years, we have built a nearly insurmountable technological lead in tolling, a roughly $200B global industry expected to double in the next decade. We work for toll authorities and state DOTs, and we own the whole system, from the roadside camera to the final bill, so every vehicle we see becomes one accurate toll transaction and nothing more. While our competitors have thousands of employees, we operate with a lean but growing team of less than 30\. Our impact is visible on the massive Interstate Highway System connecting every major US metro (except Juneau, AK—sorry, Juneau).
   

  

**You are a good fit if...**
* You love the grind: You take ownership and put in the time to meet deadlines. Our recent team survey showed an average of 55 hours/week, with occasional 70\+ hour bursts for major releases.
* You are detail obsessed: You have experience writing code, designing or building systems that stands up to the unpredictability of the physical world, where the small details are the difference between success and failure.
* You are adaptable: We are a lean team. If you only want to work on a "niche thing" or are uncomfortable helping other teams when they need a boost, this isn't the place for you. We expect you to figure out what you need to get stuff done.
* You code really well: We mostly use Python and TypeScript, but we don’t care what you’re most proficient in today—as long as you learn fast.
* You value working together in person: You’re excited to work alongside the team at our Denver office. This role is in\-office on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, with flexibility to work remotely on Tuesdays and Thursdays.


**The Mission:** 
 Every image on our system has one job: complete an accurate toll transaction through a billing system we run and audit ourselves. Your job is keeping the models behind that transaction accurate and reliable. We process 11 million images a day, using detection, segmentation, classification, embeddings, and re\-identification to match each vehicle to its toll. You'll own the infrastructure, deployment, and monitoring that take a model to the road, and the updates that keep it correct once it's there. This role is for the engineer who sees a great model stuck in a notebook and can't rest until it's running reliably in production.
   

  

**The Work**
* Own the Platform: We wire it all together and run our own servers. You own the infrastructure behind every model we ship: training and serving infrastructure, model versioning, deployment, and rollback.
* Vision at Real Scale: 11 million images a day across vehicles, license plates, wheels, and lane markings. At this volume, a faster pipeline or a cheaper inference path saves money every day.
* Real Hardware in the Real World: We own the devices in the field, so the systems you build run on roads, not just in a test environment.
* Edge and Cloud: Most of our compute lives in the cloud, where power is effectively unlimited. We're now pushing more inference onto roadside hardware, which is a completely different problem. You'll build the path that gets models onto edge devices, keeps them updated, and tells us when something drifts.
* Maintain What Matters: Your job is making sure the model stays correct. You build the monitoring that catches degradation before anyone else does, and you own the updates that fix it.
* How We Handle Data: We work only for toll authorities and state DOTs, on legislatively authorized toll roads. The laws governing our work prohibit keeping data unless it's used to charge a toll. There is no search\-by\-plate interface, no cross\-agency lookup network, and no standing law enforcement access. Data leaves our system only through the same legal process that applies to any company's billing records.


**Requirements**
* Experience: 2 to 6 years of full\-time software engineering experience building and running production systems, such as infrastructure, backend services, or ML platforms.
* Production Fundamentals: You write production\-quality code and build reliable systems: pipelines, deployment, observability, and the tooling that keeps them running.
* ML Curiosity: You don't need to design novel architectures. You may have deployed models before, or you may be a strong engineer who wants to go deep on ML. Either way, you understand, or are eager to learn, how models are trained and evaluated well enough to debug them in production.
* Python: Fluent in Python.
* Bonus: Experience taking ML models past the notebook (deployment, monitoring, retraining), deploying to edge or resource\-constrained hardware, or running your own servers instead of fully managed cloud services.


**The Interview Process**
 We're a selectively small team, which means a deliberate and thorough interview process with 3\-4 interviews and a final paid work trial. In exchange, you get real autonomy from day one, direct access to the people setting technical direction, and work that ships to roads in weeks, not quarters.
   

  

**The Essentials (Health \& Wealth)**
* Relocation Support: We are excited for you to join the team at our engineering office in Denver. We value in\-person collaboration and daily team lunches and we provide a relocation bonus to help you get here.
* Personalized Health Coverage (ICHRA): We don’t believe in one\-size\-fits\-all healthcare. We provide a monthly allowance for you and dependents so you can choose the individual plan that actually fits your life.
* Investing in Your Future: 401(k) matching up to 4%.
* Peace of Mind: Transparent compensation. Company\-sponsored life \& disability insurance.
* Early Stage Equity: Competitive equity package. Every year, we facilitate a tender process that gives you the opportunity to sell your vested shares at the same valuation as our investors.


**Rest \& Recharge 🌴**
* High\-Trust Time Off: 4 weeks of untracked PTO. We don't micromanage your calendar; we focus on your impact. Take the time you need to stay sharp and inspired.
* Family First: 12 weeks of paid parental leave for birth and adoptive parents. We want you present for the moments that matter most.
* The Deep Breath (Sabbatical): Every 5 years, take 12 weeks of fully paid leave. Go travel, write a book, or master a new hobby—then come back and tell us all about it.


**Fuel \& Community 😀**
* The Blissway Kitchen: Whether it’s breakfast to start your day or our daily group lunches, we keep the team fueled.
* Snacks Autonomy: Our kitchen is fully stocked and we mean it—if we’re missing your favorite fuel, just add it to the request list.

**About the Company** 




 Our hiring partner is building the first agentic AI platform designed to power multi\-unit franchise success, covering the entire journey from brand discovery to portfolio management. They serve three core customer groups: prospective franchisees seeking the right opportunities, current operators automating workflows and uncovering critical insights, and established brands connecting with a qualified pipeline of ambitious partners.
 



  





 Franchising is a massive, trillion\-dollar industry with over 800,000 locations across the U.S. and a rapidly expanding international footprint. Multi\-unit operators now control more than half of all franchise locations, yet the infrastructure required to build and scale these portfolios remains fragmented and outdated. Backed by leading investors and industry experts, this team is modernizing the ecosystem and unlocking its full potential.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This company is seeking a Forward\-deployed Engineer to operate at the intersection of engineering and customer success—building the technical integrations and customizations that ensure customers derive maximum impact from the platform and its AI agents.
 



  





 This is not a traditional engineering role. This individual will work directly with customers to understand their existing systems, scope integration approaches, and define the agentic capabilities that make the platform valuable across the franchise ecosystem. Success in this role requires equal comfort jumping on a call with a customer's technical team and writing production code.
 



  





 Examples of projects this engineer might work on include:
 


* Leading technical onboarding for new brand partners by connecting their existing data, CRMs, and messaging systems to the platform, enabling them to identify high\-fit franchisees and run their franchise development operations end\-to\-end.
* Developing structured, repeatable integration layers that pull accounting, payments, and employee systems into the platform, powering portfolio management for multi\-unit operators.
* Extending the agent infrastructure to support customer\-specific workflows, turning one\-off customizations into reusable platform capabilities as patterns emerge.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own customer outcomes end\-to\-end—embed with customers (including onsite where needed), understand their workflows and what success looks like in the real world, and ensure the platform delivers significant, measurable value.
* Lead technical discovery, solution design, and delivery for high\-impact customer deployments, including data onboarding, workflow configuration, and identifying new capabilities that can drive incremental customer value.
* Design, build, and maintain integrations with external partners across the franchise ecosystem.
* Work directly with customers' and partners' technical teams to scope requirements, troubleshoot issues, and ensure reliable data exchange.
* Partner with the go\-to\-market team to evaluate new partnership opportunities from a technical feasibility standpoint.
* Build internal tooling and infrastructure that makes customer and partner onboarding faster and more repeatable—transforming bespoke customer solutions into reusable platform capabilities when patterns emerge.
* Move quickly to prototype and ship whatever is needed to unblock a customer deployment or commercial deal.
* Translate field observations into product insight, serving as one of the team's best sources of feedback on what to build next.



  





**Who You Are** 



* Possesses 4\+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform engineering.
* Demonstrates strong technical skills across the stack, including comfort with TypeScript or Node.js, APIs (REST and GraphQL), SQL, databases, data pipelines, and command\-line tooling.
* Has experience building and maintaining integrations with third\-party systems in production environments.
* Is comfortable owning the full lifecycle: discovery, design, build, deploy, operate, and iterate.
* Brings a customer and partner\-facing mindset with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Is resourceful and scrappy, figuring out how to work with messy, underdocumented partner APIs and imperfect data to make things work.
* Embraces a high\-ownership mindset, driving every customer outcome and partner integration through to completion and holding oneself accountable to a high standard.
* Is naturally curious and ambitious, with a passion for going deep on new customer workflows and partner systems, and turning messy integration work into reliable infrastructure.
* Has a strong bias for action, shipping and iterating quickly without waiting for perfect specifications or complete information.
* Is fully "AI\-native," leveraging AI coding tools to amplify personal velocity and impact. This individual is eager to work in an environment where AI is a core pillar of both the product and internal operations, even if their current company does not fully embrace it.
* Prior experience in forward\-deployed, solutions engineering, implementation, or technical consulting roles is a plus.
* Prior experience in a startup or early\-stage environment is a plus.
* An interest in franchising and the local business landscape is also a plus.



  





**Why Join the Team** 



* **Meaningful Impact:** 
 Play a direct role in supporting local communities by empowering individual operators and elevating great franchise brands.
* **Ownership \& Responsibility:** 
 Own significant pieces of the business and have a direct influence on the company's strategic direction.
* **AI\-Native Culture:** 
 Be part of a team that is actively pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, both in their product and their internal workflows.
* **Benefits:** 
 Enjoy comprehensive benefits including fully\-covered healthcare options and unlimited PTO.
* **In\-Person Team:** 
 Collaborate daily with the founding team in a dynamic New York City office environment.
